dialogues.speaker: Ragged Records
dialogues.text: "Both the boat and the supplies are untouched. I could not have been more fortunate."

dialogues.speaker: Ragged Records
dialogues.text: "The agreement was that if the news makes it to Mondstadt, Priscilla should light a torch at Stormbearer Point to warn me."

dialogues.speaker: Ragged Records
dialogues.text: "I hope it all goes smoothly. If this succeeds, the power to change the way things are will be mine for the taking..."
